references.text: Parallel legislation regarding the sin offering for a person who sins unintentionally, with similar requirements for a goat as a sin offering
Introduction to the laws concerning sins committed unintentionally (בִשְׁגָגָה), using the same Hebrew expression
Further provisions about the sin offering when someone sins without knowing it
Immediate context dealing with the whole congregation's unintentional sin, while verse 27 concerns individuals
Continuation of the text describing the priest's atonement for one who sins unintentionally
The preacher speaks about unintentional sins and vows made in ignorance
Hebrews refers to offerings for sins committed in ignorance (ἀγνοημάτων), corresponding to the Hebrew בִשְׁגָגָה
